bannerDescription: Learn about Esco Laboratory Safety Institute and our mission to drive systemic safety improvement worldwide.
paragraphs: The Esco Laboratory Safety Institute is an initiative born from Esco, a leading manufacturer of precision laboratory safety equipment. For decades, our work has provided essential protection―from fume hoods and biosafety cabinets to advanced facility-wide solutions― and has given us a unique vantage point on the challenges facing modern laboratories.

We founded the Institute to move beyond our role as an equipment provider and become a driving force for systemic safety improvement worldwide. The Institute leverages this deep industry position to serve the entire life sciences industry. It was established to advance our core vision of building a more resilient and proactive safety ecosystem. By functioning as an independent center for excellence, the Institute aims to:

missions.title: Establish the Highest Standards of Practice
missions.descr: To develop and promote rigorous safety protocols and certifications that become the global benchmark for laboratory operations.

missions.title: Bridge Theory with Real-World Application
missions.descr: To provide a vital nexus where academic safety principles meet practical, hands-on training with the latest technologies and containment strategies.

missions.title: Empower a New Generation of Safety Leaders
missions.descr: To equip safety professionals and researchers with advanced skills and knowledge needed to navigate emerging risks and complex regulatory landscapes, fostering environments where discovery can thrive without compromise.
